get.description: Open in system browser. Short OpenStrudel login. Default exact redirect openstrudel://oauth/wai-vds. Returns code, state and issuer; codes expire in 120 seconds. Public client; no secret. Login/create/recovery is hosted on this origin.

nativeOwner.description: Opaque short-lived OAuth owner token, not a WAI API key.
